clinician.trajectory_summary: A 25-year-old woman with lupus presented with progressive right-sided headaches and neck pain. Initial brain MRI revealed bilateral infracerebellar and right pre-pontine hematomas. Additional imaging ruled out venous thrombosis and vasculitis but showed subdural hematomas in cervical and lumbar spinal regions. Labs showed isolated elevated PTT with a mixing study indicative of an inhibitor, and an undetectable factor VIII level confirming acquired hemophilia A (AHA). Prior antiphospholipid antibody tests were negative. Treatment with recombinant factor VIIa and rituximab led to resolving hematomas on repeat imaging.
